settings.title: A calmer way to manage your money.

settings.editor: Drift is a personal finance app for people who hate personal finance apps. No dopamine hits, no aggressive notifications — just the numbers, rendered honestly.

settings.title: Free while in beta. 12,800 people on the waitlist.

settings.editor: We don't optimize for engagement. You open Drift when you need to, not when we send a push notification.
Your financial data lives on your device. We never see your balances, transactions, or goals. Encrypted sync is optional.
Simple charts, text-heavy summaries, no gradients. We'd rather be useful than look impressive.
Drop your email. We'll send your invite as soon as a spot opens — usually within two weeks.
We don't track you. We never share your email. Unsubscribe in one click.
A personal finance app for people who'd rather not think about personal finance apps. Made in Amsterdam.
